item_short_desc: The Ka-Bar Fighting Knife is a trusted tool for outdoor enthusiasts, featuring a 7-inch serrated blade made from high carbon steel with an epoxy powder coating for enhanced durability and corrosion resistance. The blade, sharpened to a precise 20-degree angle with buff-polished edges, offers exceptional cutting power for a variety of tasks. The oval-shaped Kraton G elastomer handle ensures a secure and comfortable grip, even in wet conditions, providing reliable performance during extended use.
description: The Ka-Bar Fighting Knife is a trusted tool for outdoor enthusiasts, featuring a 7-inch serrated blade made from high carbon steel with an epoxy powder coating for enhanced durability and corrosion resistance. The blade, sharpened to a precise 20-degree angle with buff-polished edges, offers exceptional cutting power for a variety of tasks. Designed with a powdered metal butt cap and guard, this knife delivers superior balance and control, making it an essential tool for survivalists and adventurers alike. The included glass-filled nylon sheath fits standard web belts, providing a convenient and secure carrying option. Please note, this product cannot be exported to Canada due to legal restrictions.
